name: AFM level 2 task 10: Spatially Resolved Roughness And Friction
description: Treat the initial scan center as the origin. Acquire exactly three contact-mode lateral-force images centered at (0 µm, 0 µm), (+3 µm, 0 µm), and (0 µm, +3 µm), in that order. The coordinates are absolute positions relative to the initial origin, and all scan areas are assumed to lie within the calibrated scanner range. Use a scan size of 2 µm × 2 µm, resolution of 256 × 256 pixels, time per line of 0.075 s, normal-force setpoint of 5 nN, and P/I/D gains of 100/50/0. Before each move, calculate the displacement from the current center; the expected displacement vectors are (0, 0), (+3 µm, 0), and (-3 µm, +3 µm). For every location, calculate mean and average friction.
